narr: A stalled storm system centered near Galesburg Illinois brought several rounds of showers and embedded thunderstorms to northwest Illinois through the day. These showers and thunderstorms were slow moving westward across the area and were efficient rainfall producers. Trained spotters reported 2 to 4 inches of rain in Hancock and McDonough Counties that lead to flash flooding from the late morning into the late afternoon.
ev: A trained spotter reported 6 inches of water flowing over the highway. Cars are stranded on the highway and law enforcement was in the process of closing the roadway.
